description: Layered cartoon revision: empty bay plus six separate six-pose transparent character sheets. Built-in image generation; no runtime generation.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean background plate for a layered cartoon animation.
Edit target: the supplied pastel Golden Gate bay artwork.
Remove ALL FIVE creatures completely, including every head, horn, antenna, limb, tail, and creature reflection. Reconstruct the empty sky and natural water where they were. Preserve the exact camera, horizon, pastel sunset sky, Golden Gate Bridge, distant hills, purple rocky shore at right, and the standalone purple central rock at x53%, from y46% to70%. That rock is now bare. Preserve the pink and blue water and its reflections, but remove creature-shaped wakes. The empty bay must be a seamless finished painting in the same high-quality soft 3D animated-film style.
16:9 landscape, ideally 1920x1080 or larger. No animals, faces, new objects, text or borders. This is an empty environment that will receive separate animated characters.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent six-frame character animation sprite sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows, all cells exactly equal sized.
The supplied bay is an identity/style reference. Recreate ONLY the LARGE blue/lavender long-neck creature on the left, with cream-pink belly, pink feathery leaf horns, little blue arms, big happy mouth, two dark eyes. Same plush detailed 3D animated-film surface, peach light from upper left and lavender shadows.
Show SIX DISTINCT sequential full-body poses of this ONE character doing a joyful greeting, arranged left-to-right then top-to-bottom.
Frame 1: relaxed upright, both little arms down, smiling toward right.
Frame 2: head turns to audience, near arm begins lifting.
Frame 3: near arm lifted high with elbow bent, cheerful open-mouth smile, head turned to audience.
Frame 4: arm sweeps outward in a broad wave, head tilts toward right, other arm opens.
Frame 5: wave returns, eyes closed in happy blink, arm halfway down.
Frame 6: relaxed as frame 1 with arms down, eyes open.
Actual changes in limb articulation, head view and expression, not six shifted copies. Keep head/body proportions and same character identity and rendered size. Whole creature with short lower body and feet, horns and hands fully inside each cell. Baseline of feet at 90% of each cell height, head at about 12%, body center x50%. Equal padding. Each character isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No floor, water, rock, scenery, cast shadow, labels, dividers or checkerboard. Landscape 3:2 sheet, ideally 3072x2048. Exactly six frames.

Use case: background-extraction. Remove ALL the colored background and haze from this six-frame sprite sheet. Preserve the SIX characters, their exact positions, colors, poses, details, and 3x2 arrangement. Output actual transparent RGBA PNG, every pixel outside the six character silhouettes must have alpha zero. No backdrop, glow, checkerboard, ground shadow, or added objects. Preserve canvas dimensions and all character pixels; this is ONLY background removal.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: SIX-POSE SPRITE SHEET on completely transparent RGBA background. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells, landscape 1536x1024. All background pixels must have alpha zero; no gradient, colored haze, glow, floor, scenery, shadows or checkerboard. Six full-body views of the same character, same size, matching camera and light. Full limbs and appendages visible with 10% clear padding inside every cell. Feet/body baseline 90% of cell height. Same tactile, detailed, pastel 3D animated-film style as the reference bay. Reference is only for creature identity; DO NOT reproduce its environment. No text, cell outlines, or labels. Animation frames are read left-to-right, then bottom row. ONLY the round sage-green shaggy creature hugging the center rock in the reference. Cream belly, leafy tufts, pink cheeks, smiling eyes. No rock. Six sequential poses for shy peek then greeting: 1 relaxed crouch arms at sides, 2 head looks right and hand lifts to cheek, 3 stands tall with both arms raised and surprised open eyes, 4 leans right and waves its near hand, 5 happy eyes-closed laugh with hands at chest, 6 relaxed crouch as first. Real bent elbows, changing hands and head view, stable anatomy.
